tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Business Analyst & E-Commerce Consultant | Java & Integration Expert
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Business Analyst with 5+ years of professional experience bridging business requirements and technical delivery for enterprise platforms like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in requirements analysis, user stories, process mapping, cross-functional collaboration, and end-to-end PIM, ERP, and MDM integrations. Strong background in Agile environments, stakeholder management, and international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP CPQ Business Analyst
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP CPQ Business Analyst position at Sanoma Learning, supporting European Sales teams within your international organization. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce and integration solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a robust techno-functional background in bridging business requirements with complex technical ecosystems.

bullets.label: Requirements & Process Analysis
bullets.text: Worked extensively in techno-functional roles analyzing business requirements, writing user stories, functional specifications, and mapping end-to-end data flows with international stakeholders.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Designed and optimized data pipelines and integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms, ensuring high data consistency and alignment across global business channels.

bullets.label: Agile Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with product owners, business teams, and cross-functional technical groups in Agile environments, supporting UAT and driving solution delivery.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Sparring Partner
bullets.text: Acted as a key technical and functional liaison between business representatives and IT delivery teams, translating complex sales and catalog processes into robust platform solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my analytical skills and enterprise integration experience can support Sanoma Learning.

tailoring.why_company: Sanoma Learning's deep-rooted commitment to education and supporting teachers across Europe deeply resonates with me. I want to bring my techno-functional business analysis and enterprise integration expertise to Sanoma's international organization, helping shape and develop robust sales processes and solutions that directly empower European operating companies.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my 5+ years of enterprise techno-functional and integration experience to act as a trusted Business Analyst sparring partner for Sanoma Learning's product owners and sales stakeholders.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise techno-functional and integration experience bridging business and IT, I am very interested in Sanoma Learning's SAP CPQ Business Analyst role. I would love to connect and discuss how my background aligns with your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application - SAP CPQ Business Analyst - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP CPQ Business Analyst position at Sanoma Learning.

With over 5 years of professional experience in enterprise environments at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong techno-functional expertise in requirements analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and end-to-end integrations within Agile teams.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and can start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
